nodes.title: Python Programming Fundamentals
nodes.description: Master core syntax, data structures (lists, dicts), control flow, functions, and modules in Python.

nodes.title: Relational Databases & SQL Basics
nodes.description: Learn SELECT, WHERE, JOINs, GROUP BY, aggregations, and subqueries for querying relational databases.

nodes.title: Applied Math & Statistics for Data Science
nodes.description: Descriptive statistics, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, linear algebra, and calculus foundations.

nodes.title: Data Manipulation with NumPy & Pandas
nodes.description: Efficient vector operations with NumPy and data manipulation, cleaning, and transformation with Pandas DataFrames.

nodes.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Visualization
nodes.description: Build insightful charts and dashboards using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly to discover data patterns.

nodes.title: Feature Engineering & Data Preprocessing
nodes.description: Handle missing values, encoding categorical variables, feature scaling, dimensionality reduction (PCA), and feature selection.

nodes.title: Supervised Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn
nodes.description: Build, evaluate, and tune classification and regression models (Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, XGBoost).

nodes.title: Unsupervised Learning & Clustering
nodes.description: Discover hidden clusters and patterns using K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, DBSCAN, and anomaly detection.

nodes.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks with PyTorch
nodes.description: Neural network architectures, backpropagation, CNNs for computer vision, RNNs, and PyTorch framework mastery.

nodes.title: Natural Language Processing & LLM Fine-Tuning
nodes.description: Text tokenization, embeddings, HuggingFace Transformers, RAG architecture, and fine-tuning Large Language Models.

nodes.title: MLOps & Model Deployment
nodes.description: Serve ML models with FastAPI/Flask, track experiments with MLflow, containerize with Docker, and monitor model drift.

nodes.title: End-to-End Predictive Data Science Project
nodes.description: Build a production-grade data science application from data ingestion to model deployment and interactive web dashboard.

nodes.title: HTML5 & Modern CSS Foundations
nodes.description: Master semantic HTML tags, CSS Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, and CSS variables.

nodes.title: JavaScript Fundamentals & DOM Manipulation
nodes.description: Variables, data types, functions, DOM selection, event listeners, and ES6+ features (arrow functions, destructuring).

nodes.title: Git Version Control & GitHub Workflow
nodes.description: Branching, merging, commit hygiene, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and GitHub collaboration.

nodes.title: Asynchronous JavaScript & REST APIs
nodes.description: Promises, async/await, fetch API, JSON parsing, error handling, and integrating third-party REST APIs.

nodes.title: React Core Principles & Hooks
nodes.description: JSX, components, props, state (useState), side effects (useEffect), refs, and React component lifecycle.

nodes.title: Tailwind CSS & Component Design Systems
nodes.description: Utility-first styling with Tailwind CSS, custom design tokens, dark mode, animation utilities, and accessible UI components.

nodes.title: TypeScript for Web Developers
nodes.description: Type annotations, interfaces, generics, union types, type narrowing, and typing React props and API responses.

nodes.title: Advanced State Management (Zustand / Redux)
nodes.description: Global application state management, context API, Zustand store design, immutability, and state persistence.

nodes.title: Next.js App Router & Server Components
nodes.description: Full-stack React with Next.js: file-based routing, React Server Components (RSC), Server Actions, API routes, and SSR/SSG.

nodes.title: Frontend Testing & Web Performance Optimization
nodes.description: Unit testing with Vitest/Jest, component testing with React Testing Library, Core Web Vitals, code splitting, and memoization.

nodes.title: Production React/Next.js Web Application Capstone
nodes.description: Build and deploy a feature-rich, high-performance web application with full state management, API integration, and polished UI.

nodes.title: Linux Systems & Bash Shell Scripting
nodes.description: File system navigation, permissions, process management, text processing (grep, awk, sed), and automation scripts.

nodes.title: Computer Networking & Web Protocols
nodes.description: TCP/IP, DNS resolution, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxies (Nginx), firewalls, and ports.

nodes.title: Git & Code Repository Management
nodes.description: Git branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based), hooks, tagging, release management, and repository security.

nodes.title: Containerization with Docker
nodes.description: Dockerfiles, image optimization, multi-stage builds, container lifecycle, volumes, and networking.

nodes.title: Multi-Container Applications with Docker Compose
nodes.description: Define and run multi-container Docker applications (web, DB, cache) with YAML configurations and environment variables.

nodes.title: CI/CD Pipelines with GitHub Actions
nodes.description: Automated linting, testing, building, and deployment workflows triggered on git commits and pull requests.

nodes.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform
nodes.description: Provision and manage cloud infrastructure declaratively using HashiCorp Terraform HCL, modules, and state files.

nodes.title: Cloud Computing Essentials (AWS / GCP)
nodes.description: Cloud fundamentals: EC2 compute, S3 storage, IAM roles, VPC networking, RDS databases, and serverless functions.

nodes.title: Container Orchestration with Kubernetes (k8s)
nodes.description: Deploy, scale, and manage containerized applications using Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, and Helm charts.

nodes.title: Observability: Prometheus, Grafana & ELK
nodes.description: Monitor system metrics with Prometheus, build dashboards in Grafana, and centralize logs with Elasticsearch/Logstash.

nodes.title: Automated Cloud Infrastructure Capstone Project
nodes.description: Design and deploy a resilient, self-healing k8s cluster infrastructure with automated CI/CD and full monitoring.
